poses.description: Sit with legs wide. Grip your left foot and bring it toward your ear like you're holding a phone.
Spread your legs wide and raise your arms. Imagine you're a dancing monkey full of energy!
Stand with legs wide apart. Bend your knees and spread your arms like a cowboy on a horse.
Lunge forward with one leg. Raise your arms and roar like a mighty dinosaur!
On your hands and knees. Arch your back and look up like a friendly cow.
Sit tall and stack your knees. Reach one arm up and one behind your back like a magical unicorn!
Sit with one leg bent forward and stretch back. Reach your arms wide like a siren calling from the sea.
Balance on your bottom with legs and arms lifted. Paddle your arms like you're in a kayak on a river!
Stand on one leg and open your arms wide like a beautiful angel with giant wings.
Lie on your back and hug your knees to your chest. Curl up tight like a cozy egg!
Kneel tall, open your mouth wide, and stick out your tongue. ROAR like the king of the jungle!
Sit cross-legged with your hands on your knees. Breathe deeply and sit still like a wise yogi.
Slide one leg forward and stretch the other back. Rest forward and coo like a pigeon.
Get on your hands and knees and arch your back up high. Stretch and yawn like a cat waking up!
Sit and thread your arms under your bent knees. Balance and bloom open like a beautiful flower!
Balance on one leg and stretch out flat. Reach your arm up tall and straight like bamboo!
Kneel and sit back on your heels. Sit up straight and shine like a sparkling diamond!
Sit back-to-back with your partner and twist toward each other. Turn and reach like two screws winding together!
Lie flat on your back with arms crossed on your chest. Stay perfectly still like a sleeping mummy in a pyramid!
Sit facing your partner with feet touching and hold hands. Lean back and paddle together like rowing a boat!
One person sits on the other's back as they hold a flat position. Zoom downhill together like a sledge in the snow!
Sit back-to-back with your partner and link arms. Lean on each other and bloom like one big flower!
Sit facing your partner and press feet together with legs lifted. Hold hands and balance like two sailors in a boat!
Stand side by side and balance on one leg each. Press together and grow tall like two trees in the forest!
Stand up straight with feet together and arms at your sides. Rise tall and strong like a mighty mountain!
Wrap one arm under the other and one leg around the other. Balance and soar like a powerful eagle!
Sit and bring the soles of your feet together. Flap your knees up and down like butterfly wings!
Stand with legs wide and arms out. Spread your fingers and shine bright like a star!
Sit with legs straight out and fold forward to reach your toes. Squeeze tight like a clamp holding two things together!
Balance on one leg and lean your body forward with arms out like wings. Zoom through the sky like an airplane!
Sit and slide your arms under your bent legs, folding forward. Hide in your shell like a turtle!
Stand tall and sway your arms gracefully. Move slowly and beautifully like a dancer on a stage!
Sit with legs spread wide and reach forward. Stretch your wings and call like a seagull at the beach!
Lie on your tummy, bend your knees, and reach back to grab your ankles. Arch up like a bow ready to shoot!
Stand on one leg and sweep your arms gently overhead. Sway softly like a willow tree in the breeze!
Lunge wide and stretch both arms out to the sides. Stand strong and brave like a warrior ready for battle!
Sit with legs straight and fold forward to reach your toes. Open and close like an oyster hiding a pearl!
Lie on your tummy and press your hands down to lift your chest up. Rise up and hiss like a cobra!
Sit cross-legged with each foot on the opposite thigh. Float peacefully like a lotus flower on a pond.
Sit and lift your legs and arms up off the floor. Balance and rock like a little boat on the waves!
Kneel and fold forward with arms by your sides. Rest still and quiet like a smooth round rock.
Stand with legs wide, reach one arm down to your shin and the other up. Make a giant triangle!
Push up into an upside-down V shape with hands and feet on the floor. Stretch like a dog waking up!
Squat low with feet wide and hands together. Bounce and ribbit like a frog on a lily pad!
Stand on one foot and press the other to your leg. Grow tall and reach your branches to the sky!
